scope:
Verify geometry-only periodic injectivity conditions and preserve contact.

Canonical tensor-grid diagnostics, not a pressure solve, contact replacement,
material model for voids, or a certificate for arbitrary packing/remeshed grids.
condition: min eig sym(A^-1 F) > 1e-10 on EVERY canonical background tet, plus exact material-node matching and periodic-boundary tolerance
geometric_extension: reference P1 Laplacian for missing void-node displacement; never material stiffness
